remarks: Please submit highest & best offers by noon Tuesday 3/24. Welcome to 143 Partrick Ave, conveniently located in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods. Offering graciously scaled rooms, high ceilings, and beautiful details through out, you will feel right at home when you step inside. Immaculately maintained and filled with natural light, the living spaces flow seamlessly-creating the perfect setting for both entertaining and everyday living. All four bedrooms are located on the second level, providing comfortable, private retreats, while a versatile first-floor flex space with full bath, adjacent to the dramatic library with loft space, offers ideal accommodations for guests, a home office, or additional living space. The beautiful brick patio and fenced garden offer space to relax, play, and entertain outdoors. Recently refreshed with a new roof, hot water heater, paint, and numerous other upgrades. Ideally located just minutes from town, beaches, train, and Westport, life at 143 Partrick Ave is easy, elevated, and turnkey.
